youtube.titulo: Your fence post will rot (here's why)
youtube.descripcion:
Setting a wood post in a full concrete "cup" traps water at the ground line — exactly where rot starts. Six inches of gravel under the post, concrete around it (never under it), and a sloped top fix it.

For general education only. Building codes vary by location — check your local code and a licensed professional before you build.

tiktok.texto: You poured concrete all the way around your fence post? You built a cup 😬 Here's the fix. What should Norm break next?
